scope: CPU joint-action control challenge under mixed_dispatch_v1; not a learned-model or GNN win
base_plan: affinity/descent1 placement and srpt:128 ordering, charged on every call
wall_search: continuous compiled annealing, temperature follows elapsed budget fraction; reserve twice the largest observed atomic step plus wrapper margin; retain best feasible plan and reject any measured overrun
claim: Require reference headroom over the strongest eligible joint hand control, not merely over fixed-placement ordering. Pure placement and pure ordering controls are action ablations.
live_gate: 16 fresh inputs times baseline, calibration-selected control, reference: 48 runs regardless of screen outcome. All task placements and completion times must match independent replay.
future_gates: A passing headroom screen still requires equal-budget hand-graph and nonlocal residual qualification before matched training. No GPU or training corpus from headroom alone.
no_cherry_picking: Freeze the hand selector on calibration; report all fresh arm results and a posthoc per-environment strongest eligible arm envelope as a stricter diagnostic. Fresh arm outcomes cannot relax the 8% threshold.
